zh-CN.title: 双扣、麻将和不洗牌斗地主
items: 空间管理员可领取双扣和麻将常驻活动。认证成员可以开桌，直接把房间邀请发给好友或群聊。
四人双扣支持经典和火拼玩法。麻将支持吃、碰、杠、自摸和点炮胡，四人准备后可在原桌再开一局。
斗地主房主可以在两局之间切换经典和不洗牌模式。

en.title: Shuangkou, Mahjong and No reshuffle
items: Space admins can enable Shuangkou and Mahjong. Verified members can open a table and invite friends directly or in a group chat.
Play Classic or Firefight Shuangkou, or four-player Mahjong with chi, pong, kong, self-drawn wins and wins on discards. Ready up to play another round at the same table.
Dou Dizhu hosts can switch between Classic and No reshuffle between rounds.
